title: Staff turned on at release are picked up as changed by the Public API
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Have a valid Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation for staff, and a request tool (Postman or any tool that sends requests with that key).
  • Sign in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as an Admin of the production test account, at its test location, Trucks Hill 2.
  • Have a valid Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation for staff, and a request tool (Postman or any tool that sends requests with that key).
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have two new staff members for this test on production: staff member A, active, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Billable set to Yes, and staff member B, active, on the built-in Service Advisor role, with Time Clock on, Billable set to No and no work (written down with screenshots).
  • Note the moment, to the minute, just before the release reached production.
custom_steps:
1. Send the Public API request that lists staff changed since a given time, with the noted moment.
  2. Open Settings, Staff.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member A is in the list of changed staff, with "technician": true.
  • Staff member B is not in the list of changed staff.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A's row shows "Yes" and staff member B's row shows "No" in the Technician column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11883 (Story 5, Public API - technician value on staff)

  • S6-R3: “Nothing else on any staff record changes: Time Clock, Billable, Sales Representative and roles stay as they are. A staff member turned on by the step is marked as updated at that moment, so software connected through the Public API that asks which staff changed picks up the new technician value on its next check (S5-R1). Staff left off are not marked.”
  • S5-R1: “Each staff record the Public API returns includes a read-only technician value: true when the person is active, their Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on (the same rule as the staff list column, S4-R1), otherwise false. A deactivated person is always false.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs the before values taken on production shortly before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
